Flywheel plugin support

What it does

A skill that turns a claim into a source-linked evidence packet. Give it a claim about Flywheel or Bulletin, the sources it may use, and the decision the answer should inform. It returns what was checked, what was only reported, what stays unknown, the measurements behind each verdict, and a false-success control that would have caught a wrong answer.

Try it

  • Use flywheel-evidence-task to check the claim in this release note against its linked sources.
  • Assess this Bulletin feedback thread and separate reported, checked and unknown claims.
  • Check whether this readiness claim holds, with a false-success control.

Before you install

Plugin name: flywheel-evidence-task. Runtime: none; the plugin carries instructions only. The full install steps are in the plugin README.

Get help

Questions and problem reports: github.com/HarperZ9/flywheel-evidence-task/issues.
